functions.name: mcp_isr_service
functions.role: MCP251XFD interrupt service/dispatch: decode top int code (0x41..0x4a + ECC/CRC default), log Ext1: events, clear, raise DTC, pump RX/TEF to OD

functions.name: od_write_multiframe
functions.role: vm-protocol fragmented OD write (2/4/8-byte frames, ISO-TP-like sub-index)

functions.name: od_send
functions.role: OD/CAN publish core: builds 29-bit ext id (node<<5 | OD addr | dir), single + fragmented transmit via entry send vtable

functions.name: mcp_enter_sleep
functions.role: MCP251XFD ConfigureSleepMode + EnterSleepMode; aborts if int line still asserted

functions.name: node_sm_dispatch
functions.role: node state-machine tick over 10 slots x0x5c; fire OD action or report busy via slot callback

functions.name: adc_torque_handler
functions.role: ADC torque node handler: read 12-bit ADC, scale/offset, saturate, deadband, publish torque OD frame (D>ADC Torque)

functions.name: mcp_init
functions.role: MCP251XFD bring-up: reset, configure, FIFO/filter lists, StartCAN20 (Init_MCP251XFD)

functions.name: mcp_bus_diag
functions.role: MCP251XFD bus diagnostic: error-warning/passive/bus-off DTC + recovery (D>Bus_Off Status, recovering)

functions.name: mcp_read_busdiag
functions.role: VENDOR MCP251XFD bus-diagnostic read

functions.name: node_tick
functions.role: super-loop body: bus diag, controller health/re-init, node_sm_dispatch, mcp_isr_service

functions.name: dtc_set
functions.role: DTC set (ids 0x14..0x4b, DTC_MAX); sets active bit + latches pending mask; heartbeat.c

functions.name: sat_u16
functions.role: saturate/clamp signed value to u16 with limit

functions.name: power_main
functions.role: main(): node init, log serial + RDP, run super-loop calling node_tick

functions.name: node_assert_fail
functions.role: assert handler: (expr,file,line) -> 'Assertion failed' + halt

functions.name: mcp_clear_int
functions.role: VENDOR MCP251XFD ClearInterruptEvents

functions.name: u32_div
functions.role: vendor unsigned 32-bit divide (udivmod helper)

functions.name: battery_wake_handler
functions.role: battery wake-pulse node handler: assert wake GPIO, arm timed pulse (D>Battery wake pulse %d ms)

functions.name: od_timer_register
functions.role: register an OD/CAN timed action (id<16): stores cb+ctx, marks active bit

functions.name: heartbeat_publish
functions.role: publish 8-byte heartbeat OD frame, bump seq, clear pending-DTC mask

functions.name: irq_dispatcher_register
functions.role: irq_dispatcher.c: register handler for line 0/1 into slot table @0x20200d8c

functions.name: node_announce
functions.role: publish node-online/announce OD frame when not suppressed

functions.name: od_publish
functions.role: od_send wrapper, only emits on writable (type==2) OD endpoint

functions.name: vm_log
functions.role: printf-style logger varargs shim (D>/E> format strings); inner formatter FUN_000022d0

functions.name: heartbeat_tick
functions.role: set keep-alive DTC then heartbeat_publish

functions.name: dtc_set_from_diag
functions.role: DTC set from bus-diag path (error-warning/passive/bus-off)

functions.name: mcp_get_current_int
functions.role: VENDOR MCP251XFD GetCurrentInterruptEvent
